title: E-QTM-0079: the bulk-boundary correspondence from the walk operator's own spectrum: an interface between two gapped...
purpose: Experiment E-QTM-0079 in the quantum arena: the bulk-boundary correspondence from the walk operator's own spectrum: an interface between two gapped bulk phases of different winding (W=+2 next to W=-2) binds a nonzero, quantized, size-independent set of in-gap edge modes localized at the interface (8 modes, 4 at quasienergy 0 and 4 at pi, identical at sizes 32, 48, 64), while a uniform gapped phase with no interface binds exactly zero.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
